name: imap-mail
description: AI email tools independent of desktop mail apps: read, draft, edit, mark messages and explicitly send. Capability discovery and compact verified workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Manage email through AI, independently of mail apps
interface.longDescription: Discover connected accounts and capabilities; search/read messages, prepare or edit drafts with signatures and attachments, mark read/unread or starred, and send when requested. Compact reviews preserve full message content and verification. Runs on a configured Mac or Linux host without a mail app. Authenticated cloud connection, folder moves and provider OAuth are not yet implemented.
